prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-13: cairn test --hollow refused 15 of the Windows tickets, e.g. 'none of the proofs [cairn\\devices\\sudo_relay\\proofs\\test_sudo_relay.py] declares a PROVES entry for 3854f1aee8eb'. The PROVEME crossings written on Windows stored backslash paths (see tickets/3854f1aee8eb-*.log.jsonl proven_by), and cairn/tools/base/crossings.py proven_by_since_buildme hands them raw to hollow, proof_coverage and codemother. Fix both sides: normalize to posix at that reader, which also covers records already written, and write posix at the crossing.
